﻿Masses at 7 and 10 1/2 AM, on Sundays and Holy-days. Catechism from 9 1/2 to 10 1/2 AM on the same. Sermon after High Mass on said days. Vespers at 7 PM, after which the Benediction of the Most Holy Sacrament is given. Those [few Catholics] in Covington, Griffin, La Grange, Newman, and Marietta are under the charge of the Pastor of Atlanta.
﻿A new Church is about to be built here. The few Catholics in Murray, Gordon, Hall, Cherokee, Cass, and [?] Counties, are at present under the charge of the Pastor of Da[lton.]

﻿Masses on Sundays and Holydays at 7 and 10 1/2 A.M. Vespers at 7 P.M. on the same days. Catechism at 4 P.M. Sermons at 10 1/2 A.M., and after Vespers, at which many non-Catholics attend. Stations attended from Macon four times each year are: Milledgeville, Baldwin Co.; Eatenton, Putnam Co.; Irwington, Wilkinson Co.; Americus and Albany. In the latter place, a Church is about to be built.
